title: Stale books still count toward a prop's book count and consensus, so a lone fresh book can earn a B
steps: Synthetic CBB event, market player_points, 'Fake P' 18.5. Book a (fresh, 1 min old) +105/-125; books b, c, d each -110/-110 with last_update 6 hours old.
quotesFromEvent -> priceMarkets (bettable a,b,c,d, no sim) -> filterFeed with now=20:00Z.
expected: Stale books (> GRADE_CONFIG.staleMinutes) should not count toward 'books' or the consensus; with one fresh book the prop is below the 2-book minimum and ungraded.
actual: Row is kept with books=4, best=a, ev=+2.5%, grade B. The fair price is built from three 6-hour-old quotes. (With a bigger gap the row is only dropped because of the consensus-only cap, not because the support is stale.)
evidence: npx tsx /tmp/pcbb/t3.ts -> 'Fake P Over 18.5 Points books 4 a ev 2.5 B'. Best-price staleness is already fixed; this is about consensus/depth.
suspected_area: priceMarkets: byBook/full/consensus built from all quotes regardless of ts; no freshness filter before counting books
